tools.name: search_sites
tools.description: List launch platforms, directories, communities, newsletters, press and review sites that take product submissions, highest Ahrefs Domain Rating first. Every filter is optional; combine them to narrow the list.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Look up one site on Submit.co by its domain: what it costs, the link a product gets, who gets in, how much exposure it gets, and where to submit.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_sites · Public sink: get_site.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_sites · Public sink: get_site

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
